pages.title: 每日学习

Smallseparategoal 今日完成4词/最低10词;no hugeKPI. Below, a thoughtfully typeset compact learningmenu withonecourse 第1课 andonecurrentstory 雨天的小书店 /The Little Bookshop as real content objects. Story andcourse MUSTremainseparate. A smallsubordinateinline练习menu拼写听写测验混合 andonequiet建议入口. No photohero, forcedtimeline, duplicatecards, floatingrightpanel. Design looks inhabited because the content aligns beautifully, not because ofrandom art. Emphasize human learningpurpose with fine nativeproduct proportions.
pages.note: 把每日学习作为主行动；课程和故事作为继续学习入口。
